holdouts.plan: Use enchantments as the primary engine, stock the graveyard, then reuse valuable non-Aura enchantments through Anikthea while building an enchantment-creature/token board. Enchantress value and recursion matter more than Aura Voltron.
holdouts.reason: They look enchantment-synergistic but push Aura Voltron, while Anikthea specifically wants non-Aura enchantments to recur.

holdouts.plan: Resolve and protect Krenko, give him haste or repeated untaps, exponentially grow the Goblin count, then turn the swarm into combat damage, sacrifice value, or burst mana.
holdouts.reason: Expensive generic red value should not outrank cards that directly increase Krenko activations or exploit the Goblin mass.

holdouts.plan: Sacrifice creatures and tokens for value, double death-triggered abilities with Teysa, and win through drain, recursive fodder, and death payoffs.
holdouts.reason: Token quantity alone should not turn the deck into generic lifegain or +1/+1-counter go-wide.

holdouts.plan: Cast cheap spells targeting your own creatures, recycle them through Feather, protect Feather, trigger spellslinger effects, and convert repeated spell value into combat pressure.
holdouts.reason: Generic Boros combat cards should not outrank repeatable targeted spells that actually participate in Feather's engine.

holdouts.plan: Cast cheap Equipment and Auras to keep Sram drawing, efficiently attach them to a threat, and turn equip/attachment synergy into a compact Voltron engine.
holdouts.reason: Vehicles technically trigger Sram, but that alone should not make a Vehicle package strategically important in an Equipment-focused list.

holdouts.plan: Chain creatures to turn Chulane into card and land velocity, then repeatedly bounce and recast creatures to reuse cast and ETB effects.
holdouts.reason: Chulane puts lands onto the battlefield, but that should not cause pure landfall-token cards to displace creature-cast/bounce engines.

holdouts.plan: Sacrifice creatures for value, build experience, and repeatedly recur creature-based removal, ramp, tutors, and value pieces through Meren.
holdouts.reason: Meren's experience counters are on the player. Generic permanent/+1/+1 counter amplification should not be mistaken for direct support.

holdouts.plan: Connect with Brago and repeatedly blink useful nonland permanents to reuse ETBs, removal, draw and control pieces until repeated value or a loop takes over.
holdouts.reason: Brago uses plenty of artifacts as infrastructure, but artifact density should not incorrectly turn it into an artifact-token deck.

holdouts.plan: Convert every token source into additional Squirrels, then spend those bodies as sacrifice resources for removal, drain, mana and combo value.
holdouts.reason: Incidental lifegain/life-loss overlap should not outrank the much stronger token-generation and sacrifice relationships.

holdouts.plan: Ramp aggressively into Gishath, connect in combat, and maximize Dinosaur hit density and top-deck quality so Gishath's damage turns into a large board of Dinosaurs.
holdouts.reason: Beast Whisperer rewards casting creatures while Gishath cheats many directly into play; Hardened Scales has no reason to score highly without a real counter package.
